name: @floelabs/mcp-server

tools.name: get_markets
tools.description: List all active lending markets with current rates and liquidity. No API key required.

tools.name: get_open_lend_intents
tools.description: Browse open lend offers available for borrowing against. Requires any Floe API key (agent floe_... or developer floe_live_...).

tools.name: get_open_borrow_intents
tools.description: Browse open borrow requests. Use create_counter_intent to lend against one. Requires any Floe API key (agent floe_... or developer floe_live_...).

tools.name: get_intent_details
tools.description: Get full details of a specific intent by its offer hash. Requires any Floe API key (agent floe_... or developer floe_live_...).

tools.name: get_loan
tools.description: Get details of a specific loan by its numeric ID. Requires any Floe API key (agent floe_... or developer floe_live_...).

tools.name: get_user_loans
tools.description: Get all loans for a wallet address, both as borrower and lender. Requires any Floe API key (agent floe_... or developer floe_live_...).

tools.name: get_loan_health
tools.description: Check loan health: LTV, liquidation risk, accrued interest, early repayment terms. Requires any Floe API key (agent floe_... or developer floe_live_...).

tools.name: get_token_price
tools.description: Get current oracle price for collateral token. Requires any Floe API key (agent floe_... or developer floe_live_...).

market_id.description: Market ID (bytes32). If omitted, the backend uses its configured default market (USDC/USDC on Base Mainnet).

tools.name: get_wallet_balance
tools.description: Check token balances for a wallet. Requires any Floe API key (agent floe_... or developer floe_live_...).

tools.name: get_accrued_interest
tools.description: Get accrued interest and full credit status for a loan. Requires any Floe API key (agent floe_... or developer floe_live_...).

tools.name: create_lend_intent
tools.description: Build unsigned tx to create a lending offer. Solver matches it with borrowers. Requires any Floe API key (agent floe_... or developer floe_live_...).

max_ltv_bps.description: Max LTV in bps (the liquidation threshold on the resulting loan). Volatile-collateral markets (USDC/WETH, USDC/cbBTC) cap at 9500 (95%). Same-token markets (e.g. USDC/USDC) cap at 9950 (99.5%) — values above 9500 are the aggressive opt-in, only safe for short-duration loans because the interest-accrual headroom shrinks.

market_id.description: Market ID (bytes32). Omit to use the USDC/USDC same-token market on Base Mainnet — the recommended default for AI agents (no price risk, only interest-accrual liquidation).

tools.name: create_borrow_intent
tools.description: Build unsigned tx to create a borrow request. Solver matches it with lenders. Requires any Floe API key (agent floe_... or developer floe_live_...).

borrow_amount.description: Amount to borrow in raw token units

min_ltv_bps.description: Min LTV in bps (default 8000 = 80%). For agents pushing the USDC/USDC market to 99% LTV, pass 9900. Same-token markets need only a 50bps gap to the lender's max_ltv_bps; volatile markets need 800bps.

market_id.description: Market ID (bytes32). Omit to use the USDC/USDC same-token market on Base Mainnet — the recommended default for AI agents (no price risk, only interest-accrual liquidation).

tools.name: create_counter_intent
tools.description: Create a counter-intent against an existing offer. Primary way to accept offers. Solver auto-matches. Requires any Floe API key (agent floe_... or developer floe_live_...).

tools.name: repay_loan
tools.description: Build unsigned tx to repay a loan with auto-approval and slippage protection. Requires any Floe API key (agent floe_... or developer floe_live_...).

tools.name: add_collateral
tools.description: Build unsigned tx to add collateral to a loan. Requires any Floe API key (agent floe_... or developer floe_live_...).

amount.description: Collateral amount in raw token units

tools.name: withdraw_collateral
tools.description: Build unsigned tx to withdraw excess collateral. Requires any Floe API key (agent floe_... or developer floe_live_...).

tools.name: liquidate_loan
tools.description: Build unsigned tx to liquidate an unhealthy loan. Requires any Floe API key (agent floe_... or developer floe_live_...).

tools.name: revoke_intent
tools.description: Build unsigned tx to cancel an active intent. Requires any Floe API key (agent floe_... or developer floe_live_...).

tools.name: approve_token
tools.description: Build unsigned tx to approve a token for Floe protocol. Requires any Floe API key (agent floe_... or developer floe_live_...).

amount.description: Amount to approve in raw units

tools.name: check_compatibility
tools.description: Check if two intents can match. Requires any Floe API key (agent floe_... or developer floe_live_...).

tools.name: calculate_risk
tools.description: Calculate risk metrics for a potential loan position. Requires any Floe API key (agent floe_... or developer floe_live_...).

tools.name: estimate_interest
tools.description: Estimate total interest for given loan terms. Requires any Floe API key (agent floe_... or developer floe_live_...).

tools.name: simulate_transaction
tools.description: Dry-run an unsigned tx. Returns success/revert and gas estimate. Requires any Floe API key (agent floe_... or developer floe_live_...).

tools.name: broadcast_transaction
tools.description: Submit a signed transaction to Base Mainnet. Requires any Floe API key (agent floe_... or developer floe_live_...).

tools.name: get_transaction_status
tools.description: Check status of a submitted transaction. Requires any Floe API key (agent floe_... or developer floe_live_...).

tools.name: get_credit_remaining
tools.description: Return how much USDC credit the calling agent has left. Use BEFORE deciding whether to make a paid call. Two distinct numbers: `available` (= spendable USDC right now — what the proxy actually gates on) and `headroomToAutoBorrow` (= operator-delegation borrowing capacity — how much MORE the agent could draw from its credit line). These differ when the agent has delegation capacity but no facility loan opened yet: headroomToAutoBorrow > 0 does NOT imply available > 0. Use `available` for the spend gate. Requires an agent key (floe_...).

tools.name: get_loan_state
tools.description: Return the agent's coarse credit state-machine view: idle | borrowing | at_limit | repaying. Use to gate actions that only make sense in specific states (e.g. don't spend while at_limit). Requires an agent key (floe_...).

tools.name: get_spend_limit
tools.description: Return the agent's currently-active session spend cap, if any. Returns { active: false } when no cap is set. Requires an agent key (floe_...).

tools.name: set_spend_limit
tools.description: Set or update the agent's session spend cap (USDC raw, 6 decimals). Resets the session window — anything spent before this call no longer counts. Operator-defined; distinct from the on-chain creditLimit. Requires an agent key (floe_...).

limit_raw.description: Cap in raw USDC units (6 decimals), positive. e.g. "1000000" = $1.

tools.name: clear_spend_limit
tools.description: Remove the agent's session spend cap. Subsequent paid calls will only be bounded by the on-chain creditLimit. Requires an agent key (floe_...).

tools.name: list_credit_thresholds
tools.description: List the agent's registered credit-utilization thresholds. Each fires a credit.warning / credit.at_limit / credit.recovered webhook when crossed. Requires an agent key (floe_...).

tools.name: register_credit_threshold
tools.description: Register a new credit-utilization threshold. When utilizationBps crosses thresholdBps from below, the agent's webhook receives credit.warning (or credit.at_limit if >= 9500). Drops below → credit.recovered. Cap of 20 thresholds per agent. Requires an agent key (floe_...).

webhook_id.description: Optional: pin to a specific webhook owned by this developer. Omit for fanout.

tools.name: delete_credit_threshold
tools.description: Delete one of the agent's credit-utilization thresholds by id (from list_credit_thresholds). Requires an agent key (floe_...).

tools.name: estimate_x402_cost
tools.description: Preflight an x402-protected URL and return its USDC cost without paying. Reflects against the calling agent's available credit and session spend-limit so you can decide gating in one round-trip. Use BEFORE x402_pay. Requires an agent key (floe_...).

tools.name: check_x402_url
tools.description: Check whether a URL is x402-protected and, if so, what it costs — without any credential. Public probe (IP rate-limited). Returns { x402: false, status } for plain URLs or the payment requirements for x402 ones. Use to vet a vendor before minting keys or funding. No API key required.

tools.name: x402_forecast
tools.description: Batch cost forecast + policy preflight for a PLAN of paid calls (FLO-545). Given up to 50 planned x402 calls (each with an optional repeat count), returns the aggregated USDC cost projection and a policyPreflight block listing which of the agent's policies would breach if the plan ran now. Read-only — nothing is paid or mutated. Use to validate a multi-step plan in one round-trip instead of estimating call-by-call. Requires an agent key (floe_...).

count.description: How many times the plan calls this URL (default 1).

task_id.description: Optional task id for task-scoped policy preflight.

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List the models available on Floe Inference — the keyless pay-as-you-go LLM/voice gateway. Returns OpenAI-compatible model objects (id like "openai/gpt-4o", modality: text | embedding | tts | stt | realtime, context_window). Use the id with the OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions, /v1/embeddings, /v1/audio, or /v1/realtime endpoints, or price a call first with estimate_inference_cost. Requires any Floe API key (agent floe_... or developer floe_live_...).

tools.name: estimate_inference_cost
tools.description: Estimate the USDC cost of a Floe Inference call for a given model and usage vector, WITHOUT making the call or touching balance. Returns the cheapest priceable source: { rail, provider, margin_bps, upstream_cost_usdc, cost_usdc, cost_raw }. Provide only the units the model bills: text models use input_tokens/output_tokens (+cached_input_tokens); TTS uses characters; STT uses audio_seconds; realtime voice uses audio_input_tokens/audio_output_tokens. Use BEFORE inference to decide gating. Requires any Floe API key (agent floe_... or developer floe_live_...).

model.description: Model id from list_models, e.g. "openai/gpt-4o" or "elevenlabs/eleven-turbo-v2.5".

cached_input_tokens.description: Cached prompt tokens billed at the cached rate (text models).

audio_seconds.description: Seconds of audio, fractional allowed (STT models).

tools.name: set_allowlist_mode
tools.description: Set the agent's merchant-allowlist enforcement mode. "off" (default) allows any vendor. "host" blocks unlisted hosts before the first fetch; "vendor" blocks unlisted payees before signing; "both" enforces both. Allowlist entries themselves are managed with add_allowlist_entry. Requires an agent key (floe_...).

mode.description: Enforcement mode: off | host | vendor | both.

tools.name: get_allowlist_mode
tools.description: Return the agent's current merchant-allowlist enforcement mode (off | host | vendor | both). Requires an agent key (floe_...).

tools.name: add_allowlist_entry
tools.description: Add a merchant-allowlist entry — an allowed-AND-capped policy row. Use kind="api" to allowlist a host (match_key = hostname) or kind="vendor" to allowlist a payee (match_key = recipient wallet). limit_raw caps spend against this entry (raw USDC, 6 decimals). Enforcement only kicks in once set_allowlist_mode is host/vendor/both. Requires an agent key (floe_...).

kind.description: "api" for a host entry (match_key = hostname) or "vendor" for a payee entry (match_key = recipient wallet address).

match_key.description: Host (for kind="api") or payee wallet address (for kind="vendor").

limit_raw.description: Spend cap in raw USDC units (6 decimals), positive. e.g. "1000000" = $1.

match_kind.description: Optional matcher: host_exact | host_suffix (api) or recipient (vendor). Defaults server-side.

tools.name: remove_allowlist_entry
tools.description: Remove (revoke) a merchant-allowlist entry by policy id (from list_allowlist). Requires an agent key (floe_...).

policy_id.description: Policy id of the allowlist entry.

tools.name: list_allowlist
tools.description: List the agent's merchant-allowlist entries (host "api" and payee "vendor" policies) with their spend caps. Does not include session/task spend policies. Requires an agent key (floe_...).

tools.name: get_agent_reputation
tools.description: Return the calling agent's unified credit reputation: a 0-100 score, an A-E band, confidence (0-1 share of the model backed by real signals), the resulting collateral-requirement multiplier (collateralMultiplierBps; 10000 = 1.0x baseline, lower score = higher multiplier), modelVersion, and computedAt. Behavioral discipline (declined spends, policy breaches, tool-call reliability, verified-settlement diversity) feeds the score alongside repayment and payment history. Use to understand how much collateral the next borrow will require. Returns 404 until the first score is computed. Requires an agent key (floe_...).

tools.name: create_agent
tools.description: Provision a new managed agent end-to-end: agents row → Privy-managed wallet → sponsored on-chain operator delegation → $3 welcome credit auto-disbursed on the account's FIRST agent only (immediately spendable; once per account, not per agent). Defaults to pay-as-you-go funding (no credit line; upgrade later with open_credit_line). Returns agentId, privyWalletAddress (the deposit address), and delegationTxHash — NOT an API key; mint one with create_agent_key. Requires a developer key (floe_live_...).

borrow_limit_raw.description: Optional on-chain borrow limit in raw USDC (6 decimals). Omit for the pay-as-you-go default.

max_rate_bps.description: Max annual interest rate the delegation accepts, in bps (default 1500 = 15%).

expiry_seconds.description: Operator delegation lifetime in seconds (default 90 days).

tools.name: list_agents
tools.description: List every agent owned by the developer account, with status, wallets, and credit limits. Requires a developer key (floe_live_...).

tools.name: get_agent
tools.description: Get one agent's full detail: status, privyWalletAddress (deposit address), creditUsed, 24h transaction count, and session spend snapshot. Requires a developer key (floe_live_...).

tools.name: pause_agent
tools.description: Pause (suspend) one agent — the per-agent kill-switch. Every call with the agent's keys fails auth from its next request until resume_agent. Only active agents can be paused. Requires a developer key (floe_live_...).

tools.name: resume_agent
tools.description: Resume a paused (suspended) agent. Cannot resurrect closed agents or ones suspended by their own lifecycle flows (credit freeze, failed delegation). Requires a developer key (floe_live_...).

tools.name: close_agent
tools.description: Permanently close an agent: repays outstanding facility loans, sweeps unspent funds back to the developer (unspent welcome credit returns to the treasury), and disables its keys. Irreversible. Requires a developer key (floe_live_...).

tools.name: create_agent_key
tools.description: Mint a new agent API key (floe_...) for an agent — the credential its runtime tools and x402_pay use. The plaintext key is returned ONCE; store it securely and never echo it into chat. Optionally cap the key with a rolling spend budget (fail-closed). Requires a developer key (floe_live_...).

budget_raw.description: Optional per-key spend budget in raw USDC (6 decimals), positive.

window_seconds.description: Rolling budget window in seconds. Omit for the server default.

tools.name: rotate_agent_key
tools.description: Atomically revoke an agent key and mint its replacement (inherits label/permissions unless overridden). The new plaintext key is returned ONCE. Use on suspected leak or on a rotation schedule. Requires a developer key (floe_live_...).

key_id.description: Key id to rotate (from the agent's key list).

label.description: Optional new label; omit to inherit.

tools.name: revoke_agent_key
tools.description: Revoke (delete) an agent API key. Calls using it fail auth immediately. Irreversible — rotate_agent_key instead if the agent should keep running. Requires a developer key (floe_live_...).

tools.name: set_agent_key_budget
tools.description: Set or update the rolling spend budget on one agent API key (FLO-585). Fail-closed: spend attributed to the key past the budget is refused until the window rolls. A 0 budget is invalid — revoke the key to block it entirely. Requires a developer key (floe_live_...).

budget_raw.description: Budget in raw USDC units (6 decimals), positive. e.g. "5000000" = $5.

window_seconds.description: Rolling window in seconds. Omit for the server default.

tools.name: open_credit_line
tools.description: Upgrade a pay-as-you-go agent to a managed credit line: the server signs a borrow intent collateralized from the agent's wallet (which must already hold the deposit — see get_funding_instructions). Check get_credit_line_bounds first for valid deposit/LTV ranges. Requires a developer key (floe_live_...).

deposit_raw.description: Collateral deposit in raw USDC units (6 decimals), positive.

max_ltv_bps.description: Optional max LTV in bps. Omit for the server default.

max_rate_bps.description: Optional max annual rate in bps. Omit for the server default.

tools.name: get_credit_line_bounds
tools.description: Preview the valid deposit / LTV bounds and current funded balances for upgrading an agent to a credit line. Use BEFORE open_credit_line. Requires a developer key (floe_live_...).

tools.name: get_funding_instructions
tools.description: Return machine-readable funding instructions for an agent: the USDC deposit address, chain (Base, 8453), and any minimums/warnings. Hand this to the human when welcome credit runs out — funding is the one step an agent cannot do alone. Requires a developer key (floe_live_...).

tools.name: get_balances
tools.description: Aggregate USDC balances across the developer account: developer wallet, every agent wallet, and API credits. Requires a developer key (floe_live_...).

tools.name: get_activity
tools.description: Unified account activity feed: x402 proxy calls, onramps, transfers, and loan events, newest first. Filter by agent, type, or time range; paginate with the returned cursor. Requires a developer key (floe_live_...).

type.description: Filter to these activity types. Omit for all.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous page.

tools.name: get_usage_summary
tools.description: Spend/usage analytics rollup for the account: KPIs, daily series, and top endpoints over a time window. The "how is my fleet doing" one-call view. Requires a developer key (floe_live_...).

tools.name: x402_pay
tools.description: Execute a paid x402 call through the Floe proxy: Floe pays the vendor in USDC from the calling agent's balance/credit (subject to spend limits, budgets, and allowlist) and returns the vendor's response plus the X-Floe-* metering headers (cost, budget advisory, settled receipt). Pass idempotency_key (Stripe-style) so retries never double-pay. Use estimate_x402_cost or x402_forecast FIRST. Requires an agent key (floe_...).

url.description: The x402 vendor URL to call.

headers.description: Extra request headers to forward to the vendor (payment/framing headers are stripped server-side).

body.description: Raw request body string (JSON-encode it yourself for JSON APIs).

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency key: a replayed call returns the cached response instead of paying again (FLO-548).

tools.name: create_webhook
tools.description: Register a webhook endpoint for account events. Returns the signing secret ONCE — store it to verify deliveries. Subscribe to exact event names, "*", or prefix wildcards like "call.*"; call list_webhook_events for the live 30-event catalog (loan, agent, credit, call, phone, marketplace categories). Max 10 webhooks. Requires a developer key (floe_live_...).

url.description: HTTPS endpoint to deliver events to.

events.description: Event names to subscribe to — exact names, "*", or prefix wildcards like "call.*" (validated server-side; see list_webhook_events).

scope.description: Delivery scope (default global). "agent" filters to one agent by its wallet address.

scope_value.description: Wallet address (scope wallet/agent — the agent WALLET address, not the numeric agent id) or numeric loan id (scope loan). Omit for global.

tools.name: list_webhooks
tools.description: List the account's registered webhooks with their subscribed events, scope, and active flag (secrets are never returned). Requires a developer key (floe_live_...).

tools.name: list_webhook_events
tools.description: List the live webhook event catalog: every subscribable event with its name, title, description, category (loan/agent/credit/call/phone/marketplace), and scope dimension. The authoritative list for create_webhook / update_webhook events arrays. Requires a developer key (floe_live_...).

tools.name: get_webhook
tools.description: Get one webhook endpoint plus its delivery stats (pending/success/failed/retrying/total counts). Secrets are never returned. Requires a developer key (floe_live_...).

tools.name: update_webhook
tools.description: Update a webhook endpoint: change its URL, subscribed events, description, or pause/resume it via active. Scope cannot be changed after creation — delete and recreate instead. Requires a developer key (floe_live_...).

events.description: Replacement event list (exact names, "*", or prefix wildcards).

active.description: false pauses deliveries, true resumes them.

tools.name: delete_webhook
tools.description: Delete a webhook endpoint permanently. Deliveries to it stop immediately; its delivery history is removed with it. Requires a developer key (floe_live_...).

tools.name: test_webhook
tools.description: Send a signed test delivery to one webhook endpoint so you can verify connectivity and signature handling end-to-end. Requires a developer key (floe_live_...).

tools.name: rotate_webhook_secret
tools.description: Rotate a webhook's signing secret. Returns the new secret ONCE — update your receiver before old-secret deliveries stop verifying. Requires a developer key (floe_live_...).

tools.name: list_webhook_deliveries
tools.description: List the account-wide webhook delivery log (all endpoints), newest first, with cursor pagination. Rows carry event, status (pending/success/failed/retrying), HTTP status, attempt count, agent wallet, and correlation id (call id / job id / loan id) — but not payloads; use get_webhook_delivery for those. Logs are retained 30 days. Requires a developer key (floe_live_...).

endpoint_id.description: Filter to one webhook endpoint id.

event.description: Filter by exact event name (no wildcards).

from.description: Only deliveries at/after this ISO timestamp.

to.description: Only deliveries at/before this ISO timestamp.

id_search.description: Match a delivery id OR correlation id (call session id, job id, loan id).

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous response's nextCursor.

tools.name: get_webhook_delivery
tools.description: Get one webhook delivery in full: the exact payload that was sent, the sanitized response body (capped at 1KB), and the next retry time if it is still retrying. Requires a developer key (floe_live_...).

delivery_id.description: The hex delivery id (from list_webhook_deliveries rows or the X-Floe-Delivery-Id header) — not the numeric row id.

tools.name: retry_webhook_delivery
tools.description: Manually redeliver one failed webhook delivery to its endpoint. Test deliveries cannot be retried. Receivers should dedupe on the X-Floe-Delivery-Id header. Requires a developer key (floe_live_...).

webhook_id.description: Webhook id the delivery belongs to.

delivery_id.description: The hex delivery id to redeliver.

tools.name: search_floe_docs
tools.description: Search the Floe documentation index (llms.txt) and return matching pages with titles, URLs, and descriptions. Whitespace-separated terms are matched case-insensitively against a page's section, title, URL, and description; results are ranked by how many terms hit, so pages matching every term come first. Use to answer "how do I…" questions about the Floe API, x402 vendors, spend controls, or this MCP server. No API key required.
